reviewer_authority.verdict: Round 8 computational/formal PASS / VALID; scientific PARTIAL / BOUNDED INTERNAL EVIDENCE

scientific_question: Are the four Round 8 graded association-response gates robust across 20 prefixed outcome-blind map realizations rather than conditional on one map/salt?

Round8_formal_result_reference.use: q=0 bridge and historical single-map reference only

outcome_blind_map_builder.algorithm: exactly the Round 8 deterministic filename/clip/salt cycle builder
depends_only_on: clip groups obtained by removing terminal _1 or _3
hard_gate_for_every_prefixed_salt: every q source array is a global bijection
active destination and source are never the same filename
active destination and source are never from the same clip
all 20 salts and all 20 q=1 source-map hashes are unique
target-row, confidence-value, and perturbed-prediction multisets are preserved by bijection
association components derived independently for each map are source-closed for all q
each restricted map remains a bijection within every component
outcome_blind_map_builder.failure_rule: If any prefixed salt fails, STOP Round 9; do not drop or replace it.

C1.interpretation: sample-correspondence response, not natural visual severity or rationale faithfulness

metrics_and_directions.tie_rule: exact expected AURC over every ordering within an equal-confidence block
metrics_and_directions.bottleneck_order: within each map and training seed, take the minimum expected-direction adjacent step across every required component; only then average seeds and maps

primary_estimands.map_seed_bottleneck: one weakest expected-direction adjacent q step per axis, map, and training seed
primary_estimands.map_mean_bottleneck: mean of the five training-seed bottlenecks within each map
primary_estimands.grand_mean_bottleneck: mean of the 20 map-specific mean bottlenecks
primary_estimands.grand_mean_component_curves: mean component curves across all 20 maps and five training seeds

algorithm_per_replicate: sample 20 map positions with replacement from map00 through map19
sample five training-seed positions with replacement once and share this seed draw across all selected maps
for every selected map occurrence, sample that map's full association-component count with replacement
within a selected map occurrence, share its component multiset across every selected seed, q, model, axis, and perturbation
within every map occurrence and selected seed, calculate the axis bottleneck before averaging
average bottlenecks over the five selected seed positions and then over the 20 selected map occurrences
prohibited_shortcuts: average q curves before taking the minimum step
use a different map subset for different axes
hierarchical_bootstrap.interval_scope: four pointwise axis intervals, not simultaneous familywise 95 percent coverage

per_axis_PASS_requires_all: at least 18 of 20 map-specific mean bottlenecks are greater than zero
20-map grand mean bottleneck is greater than zero
hierarchical bootstrap pointwise 95 percent CI lower bound is greater than zero
20-map by five-seed grand mean component curves contain no adjacent expected-direction reversal
all 20 map results and diagnostics are reported
decision_rules.ROUND9_FULL_PASS: all exact preflight checks and all four axis PASS gates
ROUND9_FAIL_OR_INCONCLUSIVE: any axis has fewer than 18 positive maps
any axis CI lower bound is less than or equal to zero
any axis grand mean curve has an adjacent reversal
any frozen map, component, input, protocol, code, test, or reviewer hash mismatches
any new-map q>0 outcome is read before the result-blind freeze and reviewer GO
any scientific statistic or gate is modified after outcomes are exposed

outcome_governance.pre_result_implementation_failure: preserve the log, prove no formal result artifact was written, and obtain independent GO_RERUN before retrying
outcome_governance.after_Round9: terminate the BDD-OIA map-realization line; do not continue salt iteration

required_preoutcome_artifacts: 20 independently derived component partitions and manifest
synthetic tests for map legality, per-map closure, map-seed-component hierarchy, and per-seed-first bottlenecks
exact preflight proving no q>0 metric outcome was computed
required_postoutcome_artifacts: all map x seed x q primary curves and diagnostics
all 80 map-specific axis means and all 400 map x seed axis bottlenecks
four 2000-replicate hierarchical bootstrap draw arrays and summaries
compact primitives sufficient for independent reproduction

claim_boundaries.PASS_supports: The four Round 8 BDD-OIA graded response gates are robust across 20 prefixed outcome-blind legal map realizations under map-by-seed-by-association-component conditional inference.
PASS_does_not_support: ontology completeness or every rationale class
calibration validity or a safety guarantee
other datasets, architectures, training protocols, thresholds, metrics, or real-world driving
